newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia to issue Eurobond in two weeks - Livshits.
newsitem.headline: Russia to issue Eurobond in two weeks - Livshits.

text.p: Finance Minister Alexander Livshits said on Thursday Russia would issue its second Eurobond within two weeks, folowing the completion of a road-show.
Livshits said on Ekho Moskvy radio that on Friday he would announce the list of Russian banks which will co-lead the mark-denominated issue.
Russia has already chosen CS First Boston and Deutsche Morgan Grenfell to lead-manage the issue.
Russia issued its first $1 billion heavily oversubscribed Eurobond in November, and the government said it planned to raise $3 billion through Eurobond issues in 1997.
Livshits said previously the volume of the second issue would be one billion marks ($592.6 million), but Foreign Economy Minister Oleg Davydov said the volume may amount to 1.5 billion.
